class.name: StandaloneActivityLauncher
class.brief_description: Default [ActivityLauncher] that bootstraps a minimal [StandaloneApplication] when an [Activity], [Dialog], or [Toast] scene is opened as the entry scene.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the launcher claims the node regardless of its position in the scene tree. Default [code]false[/code] — only the entry-scene node is bootstrapped.
If [code]true[/code], the node's [code]transition_in[/code] plays during the standalone bootstrap. Default [code]false[/code].
